destination.name: Yixing
destination.tagline: A teapot town on Lake Tai's west shore with bamboo hills and karst caves
destination.description: Yixing is a county-level city on the west side of Lake Tai with more than 7,000 years of pottery making. It is known for stoneware, especially teapots made from the local clay, which the Yixing Ceramics Museum in Dingshu town traces from Neolithic pottery to Qing zisha ware. The hills to the south hold a bamboo forest park and several cave scenic areas, and Shanjuan Cave is among the earliest cave attractions in China. Nanjing to Hangzhou high-speed trains stop at Yixing station.

goodToKnow.title: Sights are spread out
goodToKnow.detail: Bamboo Sea is 31 km southwest of the city and Shanjuan Cave about 25 km away, so plan on buses or a car.

goodToKnow.title: Arrive in Dingshu town
goodToKnow.detail: Yixing station and the ceramics museum are both in Dingshu town, so teapot sights start close to the train.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Spring and autumn are mild, while summers turn hot and humid. Aim for {months}.
